name: Deno runtime landing page by deno.com
description: A developer-focused landing page alternates a restrained white documentation-like canvas with deep charcoal feature bands, using bright mint green for badges, buttons, highlights, and active code states. The page starts with a compact announcement and navigation, then moves from a dark split hero into installation commands, code-led capability sections, security cards, benchmark grids, deployment integrations, social proof, and a final product CTA; the rhythm broadens from dense technical proof to spacious editorial blocks before resolving in a dark multi-column footer.
